items.result: Close IdleNoProgress at 5000ms; ready=true; last_progress=0. The existing test feeds sample_count 0 and still expects StartupNoInput at 60000ms.

items.title: ordered PCM and sub-threshold audio do not refresh progress; the input hold is one absolute begin_to_end
items.premise: enforce, idle 5000; ordered first turn; RTC frames dropped after input_frame(len); Receiving starts at 1000ms with the default 7000ms budget; further packets call input_frame and the same deadline
items.result: generation stays 1; Keep at 7999ms; Close IdleNoProgress at 8000ms while packets continue. Wake-only no_task sets Phase::Terminal and clears the Input hold without starting an LLM turn.

items.title: reply hold does not renew, and a PCM stall after started+40s closes a live turn
items.premise: enforce, idle_ms=5000, turn.started=T, task still unfinished at T+45s, captured_samples unchanged from T+40s to T+45s, no other hold
items.result: same Instant, generation 1; Close IdleNoProgress at T+40s. Continuous captured_samples growth keeps the room. Real TTS gap frequency was not measured.

items.title: search polling publishes one absolute deadline
items.premise: actor loop republishes the current poll_until; the 1s tick does not assign poll_until
items.result: 4.5s submit budget then a single now+80s poll deadline. A queued notice can hold at most its own 10s expires after polling ends. Not an infinite renewal.

items.title: VAD at or above 0.6 refreshes progress with no duration cap
items.premise: at least one 32ms window with p>=0.6 inside every idle_ms
items.result: the room stays. Matches the accepted fresh-VAD rule. No corpus shows whether real singing stays above 0.6.

items.result: the second stage does not restart 60s. A stuck prebuild does not block the room loop and aborts with the pipeline. StartupNoInput ends once any len>0 frame sets ready.
